starting-off-talking-to-jorral.text: If the player has a master clue with instructions to talk to Jorral:

steps.speaker: Jorral
steps.text: Stop! I can't help you unless you help me out first.

starting-off-talking-to-jorral.text: If the player does not meet the requirements for Making History:

steps.speaker: Jorral
steps.text: Don't bother, you're not experienced enough to help me!

starting-off-talking-to-jorral.text: If the player meets the requirements for Making History:

steps.speaker: Jorral
steps.text: Just look around you! This great building will soon be in ruin.

steps.speaker: Jorral
steps.text: Of course! This building has a history spanning generations!

steps.player: Ah, I see, a great history. But why will it be in ruin?

steps.speaker: Jorral
steps.text: It's to be ripped apart to make way for King Lathas' new alchemists' lab.

steps.player: Does the king not respect the outpost's GREAT history?

steps.speaker: Jorral
steps.text: Well, actually nobody knows what the history is. But there must be something.

steps.speaker: Jorral
steps.text: Wait a minute. You could help me!

steps.speaker: Jorral
steps.text: Yes! Uncover the history of this building to convince King Lathas to leave it alone. Do you want to know more?
A cutscene appears.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.text: With many occupants over the years...

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.text: ...the building has seen much action.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.text: It started life as an outpost...

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.text: ... its sole purpose being to see invading armies...

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.text: ... before they saw the city of Ardougne.

steps.speaker: Jorral
steps.text: If all goes well, I hope to be able to turn it into a museum as a monument to the area's history. What do you think?

steps.player: OK, I will make a stand for history!

steps.speaker: Jorral
steps.text: Oh thank you so much, you really are my saviour!

steps.player: What do I need to do now?

steps.speaker: Jorral
steps.text: There are three people that may be able to help:

steps.speaker: Jorral
steps.text: There is a silver trader in East Ardougne called Erin, who I believe can help.

steps.player: In what way can he help?

steps.speaker: Jorral
steps.text: His Great Grandfather lived in this outpost according to the records. He must know something!

steps.player: OK, I'll see what he has to say.

steps.speaker: Jorral
steps.text: I've been told that there's a ghost far off in Port Phasmatys that moans of losing his life to this place.

steps.player: Sounds ominous. Does he have a name?

steps.speaker: Jorral
steps.text: He does indeed. It's Droalak.

steps.speaker: Jorral
steps.text: It might not be so simple! You'll need an amulet of ghostspeak to talk to him!

steps.player: I've conversed with the dead before, that shouldn't be too much of a problem.

steps.speaker: Jorral
steps.text: Up near the mountains, in Rellekka is a warrior called Dron whom I have spoken to in the past. He is always on the lookout for information that can improve his fighting and commanding skills.

steps.player: And how's he related to this outpost?

steps.speaker: Jorral
steps.text: He isn't directly, but he's studied many wars, and as this used to be an outpost it should have been involved in some war.

steps.speaker: Jorral
steps.text: He isn't the easiest person to talk to, so you may need to speak to his brother, Blanin, first.

steps.speaker: Jorral
steps.text: What do you mean? You've discovered nothing!

options.text: What do I need to do now?

steps.player: I don't care about some dusty building.

steps.speaker: Jorral
steps.text: It's doomed. DOOMED!

options.text: I don't care about some dusty building

talking-to-erin.text: If the player talks to the silver merchant after stealing from his stall:

steps.speaker: Erin
steps.text: You're the one who stole something from me!

steps.speaker: Erin
steps.text: Guards guards!

talking-to-erin.text: If the player talks to the silver merchant without stealing from his stall:

steps.speaker: Silver merchant
steps.text: Silver! Silver! Best prices for buying and selling in all Kandarin!

steps.speaker: Silver merchant
steps.text: That I am. What do you want? You realise I'm working here.

steps.player: This shouldn't take too long. I just want to ask you a bit about your great Grandfather, the one who lived in the outpost?

steps.speaker: Silver merchant
steps.text: What's it to you?

steps.player: I'm doing some research for a man called Jorral. Apparently the King is going to make the outpost into his very own alchemists' lab.

steps.speaker: Silver merchant
steps.text: That can only cause chaos! Well, my great Grandfather lived and died there according to my mother, but even she knows very little about him.

steps.speaker: Silver merchant
steps.text: The only thing I have of his is a key. It's a strange key, it changes temperature by itself as you walk around. I'm afraid I don't know what it's for though.

steps.speaker: Silver merchant
steps.text: Well, I imagine it's to some sort of chest of his belongings as it's too small for a door. Perhaps if you find some of his belongings you will discover some clues amongst them.

steps.player: It's better than nothing. Will you lend it to me then?

steps.speaker: Silver merchant
steps.text: Why not. I can't use it anyway. Try feeling its change in temperature as you walk around.

talking-to-erin-talking-to-erin-again.speaker: Silver merchant
talking-to-erin-talking-to-erin-again.text: Silver! Silver! Best prices for buying and selling in all Kandarin!

steps.speaker: Silver merchant
steps.text: Keep trying. Have you noticed that the key changes temperature as you walk around?

navigating-with-the-enchanted-key-intera.text: If the journal is below the player's feet:

steps.text: The key is steaming. It must be right below your feet.

navigating-with-the-enchanted-key-intera.text: If the player is within 50 tiles from the journal:

steps.text: Ouch! It's burning hot

navigating-with-the-enchanted-key-intera.text: If the player is within 100 tiles from the journal:

steps.text: It's hot

navigating-with-the-enchanted-key-intera.text: If the player is within 150 tiles from the journal:

steps.text: It's warm

navigating-with-the-enchanted-key-intera.text: If the player is within 200 tiles from the journal:

steps.text: It's cold

navigating-with-the-enchanted-key-intera.text: If the player is more than 200 tiles from the journal:

steps.text: It's freezing

navigating-with-the-enchanted-key-after-.text: If the player is within 50 tiles and moves further away:

steps.text: Ouch! It's burning hot but colder than last time

navigating-with-the-enchanted-key-after-.text: If the player is within 50 tiles and moves closer:

steps.text: Ouch! It's burning hot and warmer than last time

navigating-with-the-enchanted-key-after-.text: If the player is within 100 tiles and moves further away:

steps.text: It's hot but colder than last time

navigating-with-the-enchanted-key-after-.text: If the player is within 100 tiles and moves closer:

steps.text: It's hot and warmer than last time

navigating-with-the-enchanted-key-after-.text: If the player is within 150 tiles and moves further away:

steps.text: It's warm but colder than last time

navigating-with-the-enchanted-key-after-.text: If the player is within 150 tiles and moves closer:

steps.text: It's warm and warmer than last time

navigating-with-the-enchanted-key-after-.text: If the player is within 200 tiles and moves further away:

steps.text: It's cold but colder than last time

navigating-with-the-enchanted-key-after-.text: If the player is within 200 tiles and moves closer:

steps.text: It's cold and warmer than last time

navigating-with-the-enchanted-key-after-.text: If the player is more than 200 tiles and moves further away:

steps.text: It's freezing but colder than last time

navigating-with-the-enchanted-key-after-.text: If the player is more than 200 tiles and moves closer:

steps.text: It's freezing and warmer than last time

navigating-with-the-enchanted-key-findin.text: If the player digs while the key is steaming:

steps.text: You use the spade and find a chest. Wonder what's inside?

navigating-with-the-enchanted-key-findin.text: If the player feels the key while the chest is in their inventory:

steps.text: You already have the chest

navigating-with-the-enchanted-key-findin.text: If the player feels the key while the journal is in their inventory:

steps.text: You've already delivered the journal

navigating-with-the-enchanted-key-findin.text: If the player feels the key while the journal is in their inventory:

steps.text: You already have the journal

navigating-with-the-enchanted-key-findin.text: If the player talks to Jorral after finding the chest:

steps.speaker: Jorral
steps.text: How's it going?

steps.speaker: Jorral
steps.text: Best you look inside then.

navigating-with-the-enchanted-key-findin.text: If the player uses the enchanted key on the chest:

steps.text: You look in the chest and find a journal, and then you throw away the chest.
a Journal

navigating-with-the-enchanted-key-findin.text: If the player talks to Erin with the journal in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Silver merchant
steps.text: Silver! Silver! Best prices for buying and selling in all Kandarin!

steps.player: Would you like to see the journal I have found?

steps.speaker: Silver merchant
steps.text: Let's have a look.
Erin reads the Journal.

steps.speaker: Silver merchant
steps.text: Very interesting. Best you show it to Jorral at the outpost.

steps.player: I was just about to. Do you want the key back?

steps.speaker: Silver merchant
steps.text: Keep it, it may come in handy.

navigating-with-the-enchanted-key-findin.text: If the player talks to Jorral with the journal in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Jorral
steps.text: How's it going?

steps.speaker: Jorral
steps.text: Good work. Let's see what it says.
Jorral reads through the journal.

steps.speaker: Jorral
steps.text: The person who wrote the journal spent time living in the outpost, following the order of Zamorak.

steps.speaker: Jorral
steps.text: He talks of all the nasty things they did to the people of Ardougne, which I don't care to mention! It looks like they were stopped by someone. But it doesn't say who.
If he was the last person to talk to:

steps.section: After talking to the last person
steps.text: Continues on to the last person dialogue

talking-to-droalak.text: If the player does not have the ghostspeak amulet equipped:

steps.speaker: Droklak
steps.text: wooo wooo

talking-to-droalak.text: If the player talks to Droalak with the amulet equipped:

steps.speaker: Droalak
steps.text: Wow. I haven't spoken to the living for... for... I don't remember how long.

steps.speaker: Droalak
steps.text: Sorry, yes I am he.

steps.player: Great. Do you know anything about the outpost North of Ardougne?

steps.speaker: Droalak
steps.text: I don't really like to talk about it, but I died there.

steps.speaker: Droalak
steps.text: I do have a scroll which might interest you that describes the timeline of the outpost. But first I wonder if I could ask you to tie up a problem?

steps.speaker: Droalak
steps.text: Well, I left to go to the outpost against the wishes of my wife. I promised I would return to her, but obviously I did not as I died there. She's a ghost nearby, but won't listen to my apologies.

steps.player: You want me to patch things up?

steps.speaker: Droalak
steps.text: Yes, how'd you guess?

steps.speaker: Droalak
steps.text: OK, well perhaps you could give her a strung sapphire amulet, because this is what I gave her the day I left. Her name is Melina by the way.

talking-to-droalak.text: If the player speaks to them again with the amulet equipped:

steps.text: If the player has an unstrung sapphire amulet:

steps.speaker: Droalak
steps.text: I said it needed to be a STRUNG sapphire amulet - best get some string!
If the player has a strung sapphire amulet:

steps.speaker: Droalak
steps.text: Good work. Just give it to Melina, who's wandering somewhere nearby.
If the player has another amulet or no amulet:

steps.player: What do you want me to do again?

steps.speaker: Droalak
steps.text: Make a strung sapphire amulet and give it to Melina!

talking-to-droalak.text: If the player speaks to them again without the amulet equipped:

steps.speaker: Droklak
steps.text: wooo wooo

talking-to-droalak-talking-to-melina.text: If the player talks to Melina without a ghostspeak amulet equipped:

steps.speaker: Melina
steps.text: wooo wooo

talking-to-droalak-talking-to-melina.text: If the player talks to Melina with a ghostspeak amulet equipped:

steps.text: If the player has an unstrung sapphire amulet or another amulet:

steps.speaker: Melina
steps.text: Oh why did he leave me? Did he truly love me?

steps.player: Erm. I think you're talking about Droalak. I believe he did love you and he's very sorry for leaving you!

steps.speaker: Melina
steps.text: You're giving me empty words. That is all.
If the player has an strung sapphire amulet in their inventory:

steps.player: If you don't mind me asking, are you Melina?

steps.speaker: Melina
steps.text: That I am. What's it to you?

steps.player: I've been talking to Droalak. I believe he left you but never returned.

steps.speaker: Melina
steps.text: He did. I suppose he has asked you to tell me he's sorry. What an empty gesture!

steps.player: Well actually he told me to give you this amulet.

steps.speaker: Melina
steps.text: A sapphire amulet! He remembers! It's just like the one he gave me before he left.

steps.speaker: Melina
steps.text: I'm so glad. Please, tell him I forgive him!

steps.speaker: Melina
steps.text: At last I feel complete. Fare well.
Melina disappears, taking the player's sapphire amulet.

talking-to-droalak-talking-to-droalak-ag.text: If the player does not have a ghostspeak amulet equipped:

steps.speaker: Droalak
steps.text: wooo wooo

talking-to-droalak-talking-to-droalak-ag.text: If the player has a ghostspeak amulet equipped:

steps.player: I've given her the amulet. She was very pleased and said she just wanted to know you still cared.

steps.speaker: Droalak
steps.text: Excellent! I am so glad she believes me. I can finally rest in peace.

steps.player: Could I have that scroll you mentioned first?

steps.speaker: Droalak
steps.text: Of course. Let me know if it was of any use and then I can be forever free.
If the player does not have enough inventory space:
Droalak drops a scroll on the ground.
If the player has enough inventory space:
a scroll

talking-to-droalak-talking-to-droalak-ag.text: If the player has lost the scroll:

steps.player: Thank's for the scroll, but I seem to have lost it.

steps.speaker: Droalak
steps.text: It's a good job I stuck around then isn't it! Have another copy.
a scroll

talking-to-droalak-talking-to-droalak-ag.text: If the player talks to Droalak with the scroll in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Droalak
steps.text: Take that scroll to Jorral in the outpost.

talking-to-droalak-talking-to-jorral.player: I have been in contact with the ghost you suggested, and I've recovered this:

talking-to-droalak-talking-to-jorral.text: Jorral skims over the contents of the scroll

talking-to-droalak-talking-to-jorral.speaker: Jorral
talking-to-droalak-talking-to-jorral.text: Very interesting. So there was a great battle at the outpost. Then one of the survivors became king, and the other started the market place. Good work.
If he was the last person to talk to:

steps.section: After talking to the last person
steps.text: Continues on to the last person dialogue

talking-to-dron.speaker: Dron
talking-to-dron.text: Look, I don't have time for weaklings, if you want conversation, talk to my brother Blanin!

talking-to-dron-talking-to-blanin.player: Hello there. Are you the brother of Dron?

talking-to-dron-talking-to-blanin.speaker: Blanin
talking-to-dron-talking-to-blanin.text: That I am. Why? Has he killed one of your family?

talking-to-dron-talking-to-blanin.speaker: Blanin
talking-to-dron-talking-to-blanin.text: Oh good, how can I help you?

talking-to-dron-talking-to-blanin.player: Well I'd like to talk to your brother Dron about the outpost North of Ardougne.

talking-to-dron-talking-to-blanin.speaker: Blanin
talking-to-dron-talking-to-blanin.text: I'm afraid he's not easy to talk to, so it's good that you came to see me. You'll need to remember a few things when talking to him.

talking-to-dron-talking-to-blanin.speaker: Blanin
talking-to-dron-talking-to-blanin.text: You must be firm with him and don't mention that I sent you. In case he asks, he wields an iron mace in battle, eats rats for breakfast, kittens for lunch and bunnies for tea!

talking-to-dron-talking-to-blanin.speaker: Blanin
talking-to-dron-talking-to-blanin.text: His favorite drink is red spider blood, he's 36 years, 8 months and 21 days old, studies famous battles of the Fourth and Fifth ages, lives on the North East side of town and his, erm... pet cat is called Fluffy.

talking-to-dron-talking-to-blanin.speaker: Blanin
talking-to-dron-talking-to-blanin.text: I know this sounds strange but Dron won't talk to anyone unless they know him well - he's a secretive guy.

talking-to-dron-talking-to-dron-again.player: I need to talk to you.

options.text: Erm, sorry I don't mean to cause offence.

steps.player: Erm, sorry I don't mean to cause offence.

steps.text: A random incorrect dialogue from below is shown.
A random incorrect dialogue from below is shown.

steps.speaker: Dron
steps.text: But how do you know me?

options.text: I just talked to your brother.

steps.player: I just talked to your brother.

steps.speaker: Dron
steps.text: Don't talk of my brother. He's not on my good side at the moment.

options.text: Why, you're the famous warrior Dron!

steps.player: Why, you're the famous warrior Dron!

steps.speaker: Dron
steps.text: If so, what weapon do I use?
A random incorrect dialogue from below is shown.

steps.speaker: Dron
steps.text: When do I like to eat rats?

steps.speaker: Dron
steps.text: When are kittens best devoured?
A random incorrect dialogue from below is shown.

steps.speaker: Dron
steps.text: What do I usually eat for tea?

steps.speaker: Dron
steps.text: What colour spider blood tastes the best?
A random incorrect dialogue from below is shown.

steps.speaker: Dron
steps.text: How many years old am I?
A random incorrect dialogue from below is shown.

steps.speaker: Dron
steps.text: and months?

steps.speaker: Dron
steps.text: What are the most interesting ages for battles?
A random incorrect dialogue from below is shown.
A random incorrect dialogue from below is shown.

steps.speaker: Dron
steps.text: And my house is situated where?
A random incorrect dialogue from below is shown.

steps.speaker: Dron
steps.text: What is my brother's name?

steps.speaker: Dron
steps.text: And my pet cat is called?

steps.speaker: Dron
steps.text: What's 5 plus 7?

options.text: 12, but what does that have to do with anything?

steps.player: 12, but what does that have to do with anything?

steps.speaker: Dron
steps.text: Everything! Besides, it's 13!

steps.player: Er, I think you'll find it's 12.

steps.speaker: Dron
steps.text: Very well, you seem to know me quite well, I'll answer your questions best I can.

steps.speaker: Dron
steps.text: Well what are they then?

steps.player: I'm trying to find out the history of the outpost near Ardougne. I was hoping you could help me.

steps.speaker: Dron
steps.text: Let me see. Ah yes, I remember reading of a battle that took place at the outpost many years ago. Two ex- friends led forces in a small battle that ended with them pitted against each other at the top of the outpost as the

steps.speaker: Dron
steps.text: sole survivors because of their superior strength.

steps.speaker: Dron
steps.text: They were once friends but a difference in their beliefs meant they fell out. One chose to follow the god Zamorak, whilst the other chose Saradomin. But finding themselves in this extreme situation at the top of the

steps.speaker: Dron
steps.text: outpost caused them to see the errors of their ways, like the waste of life, the lost friendship and the wasted time. They both then decided to unite under Guthix.

steps.speaker: Dron
steps.text: You would.

steps.player: Thank you, I can report this back to Jorral now.

steps.speaker: Dron
steps.text: Anything else?

steps.player: Well, I was wondering how you get the blood stains out of your clothes?

steps.speaker: Dron
steps.text: BE GONE!
A random incorrect dialogue from below is shown.
A random incorrect dialogue from below is shown.

steps.speaker: Dron
steps.text: Dev?

steps.speaker: Dron
steps.text: What a strange name. Unlike my brothers!
A random incorrect dialogue from below is shown.
A random incorrect dialogue from below is shown.
A random incorrect dialogue from below is shown.
A random incorrect dialogue from below is shown.

steps.speaker: Dron
steps.text: Eww. Gross. You have some strange tastes.

steps.player: You can't lecture ME on eating habits.

steps.text: A random incorrect dialogue from below is shown.
A random incorrect dialogue from below is shown.
A random incorrect dialogue from below is shown.
A random incorrect dialogue from below is shown.

steps.speaker: Dron
steps.text: Don't waste my time!

steps.speaker: Dron
steps.text: You know nothing!

steps.speaker: Dron
steps.text: Leave me alone!

steps.speaker: Dron
steps.text: Wrong, wrong, wrong!

talking-to-dron-talking-to-jorral-after-.player: And then I asked him about getting the blood stains out of his clothes, but he didn't like that!

talking-to-dron-talking-to-jorral-after-.speaker: Jorral
talking-to-dron-talking-to-jorral-after-.text: It seems you're lucky he didn't beat you up! Well done, that's another piece of the puzzle.
If he was the last person to talk to:

steps.section: After talking to the last person
steps.text: Continues on to the last person dialogue

after-talking-to-the-last-person.speaker: Jorral
after-talking-to-the-last-person.text: It all makes sense now, I never realised there was quite so much history to this place, it was more than I could have hoped.

after-talking-to-the-last-person.player: I'm glad to hear. What's the whole story?

after-talking-to-the-last-person.speaker: Jorral
after-talking-to-the-last-person.text: Many years ago, there were two friends who fell out over their difference of opinion in religion. One decided to dedicate his life to Saradomin, the other to Zamorak. Years passed and the follower of Zamorak moved into

after-talking-to-the-last-person.speaker: Jorral
after-talking-to-the-last-person.text: this outpost with a group of others to cause havoc for the city of Ardougne. The people of the city called upon some Saradomin followers, who happened to be led by the other friend. A battle ensued that ended with the

after-talking-to-the-last-person.speaker: Jorral
after-talking-to-the-last-person.text: two ex-friends at the top of the outpost as the sole survivors. Realising their mistakes they made friends again. One decided to become King and spread the word of equality, and the other chose to start up a

after-talking-to-the-last-person.speaker: Jorral
after-talking-to-the-last-person.text: market where all could trade their wares equally and fairly. The one that became king is the great grandfather of the King Lathas that we know!

after-talking-to-the-last-person.player: So what should I do now?

after-talking-to-the-last-person.speaker: Jorral
after-talking-to-the-last-person.text: Well, what I'll do is write down the details you have provided in a more easy to digest manner, along with my plans for using this building as a museum.
If the player does not have enough inventory space for the letter:

steps.speaker: Jorral
steps.text: Well I would give you the letter if you had space to carry it.

after-talking-to-the-last-person.text: If the player has one free inventory space:

steps.text: a letter

steps.player: Then I suppose you want ME to deliver it to the king?

steps.speaker: Jorral
steps.text: You've got that right!

after-talking-to-the-last-person.text: If the player loses the letter:

steps.player: Don't suppose you could give me the letter again?

steps.speaker: Jorral
steps.text: Ok. Just don't lose it again!
a letter

after-talking-to-the-last-person-talking.speaker: Jorral
after-talking-to-the-last-person-talking.text: Have you taken that letter to King Lathas in Ardougne yet?

after-talking-to-the-last-person-talking.speaker: Jorral
after-talking-to-the-last-person-talking.text: Any time soon would be great.

talking-to-king-lathas.text: If the player forgot to get the letter from Jorral:

steps.player: Excuse me. I have been asked to give you from Jorral... Ooops, I had a letter, but I don't have it with me - be right back!

talking-to-king-lathas.text: If the player has the letter from Jorral:

steps.player: Excuse me. I have been asked to hand you this from Jorral at the outpost.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: I see.
The King reads the letter.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: I had no idea that place had any value at all! All this about my Great Grandfather and Jorral's plans to make it into a museum makes for a convincing case.

steps.player: I am sure he only wants what is best.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: Very well, I will comply with his request. Take this letter back to him with my kind regards.
a letter

talking-to-king-lathas.text: If the player loses the letter:

steps.player: Excuse me sire, but I seem to have lost that letter you gave me.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: Very well, take another.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: Have you taken that letter to Jorral yet?

delivering-the-letter-to-jorral.text: If the player forgot to get the letter from King Lathas:

steps.player: I was given a letter to give to you from the king! But I seem to have lost it!

steps.speaker: Jorral
steps.text: Perhaps he will give you another one.

delivering-the-letter-to-jorral.text: If the player has the letter from King Lathas:

steps.player: I've been to see the king and he gave me this letter.

steps.speaker: Jorral
steps.text: Quick, let me see.
Jorral reads the letter.

steps.speaker: Jorral
steps.text: Hurrah! Good work, you've done it. You've saved the outpost!

steps.speaker: Jorral
steps.text: I can now continue with my plans for this place. Thank you.

steps.speaker: Jorral
steps.text: Take a look at the artefacts in the new museum room. You may find something of interest.
Congratulations, quest complete!

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-drolak.player: I have delivered the scroll, you can rest in peace now.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-drolak.speaker: Droalak
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-drolak.text: Thanks for telling me! I've been waiting for ages!
